notes.title: Veil of Shadows - DEMO-1.2.0!

This version contains a lot of changes that improves player's game feel, as well as bug fixes.

[*] We've implemented 14 achievements, being 1 exclusive for the DEMO version
[*] Now it rains!
[*] Wind and water shaders
[*] We have butterflies
[*] Show an alert when you get the bow stolen
[*] A popup will show when you get a consumable or an item quest to carry

[*] BUG FIX: Checkpoint was not deactivating in certain situations
[*] BUG FIX: Blocking interaction with multiple elements at the same time
[*] BUG FIX: Secondary shot was colliding with some unwilling elements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
Know bugs:
[list]
[*] There is a flickering, for a frame on the bow color in transitioning from idle to shooting animation.
[*] There are few pixels licking from the mask to change the bow color
[*] In an edge case, it's possible to get the first memory fragment and get stuck on the dialog and the fragment is not really receive by the player. in this case, only a new game will make it possible to get that fragment.
[/list]

[i]We are investigating all the known bugs and will fix as quick as we can[/i]

notes.title: Veil of Shadows - DEMO-1.1.8!
notes.content:
📢Release notes demo-1.1.8:

This version contains a lot of changes that improves player's game feel, as well as bug fixes.

Changes & Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Access the progress screen when it's playing, no need to pause the game and go to the progress screen. By default the command is X on keyboard and Select on gamepad.
[*] Because of the change above, some of the controls have moved when using Gamepad, please check the config screen
[*] An exclamation mark is now visible above NPCs with quests to be done. When it's yellow it will be your first intereaction, when it's blue, there is a mission in course for that NPC.
[*] Some adjustments were done on the Random Number management, that will reflect on all random events in the game. (More work will be done on it)
[*] New animations were added to Flinn (Fisher boy) and all ghosts
[*] Now, during the rest the time passes 10x faster, that will make the cooldown of ended events pass faster
[/list]
[list]
[*] BUG FIX: When your controller got disconnected and you try to user another controller instead, it would get stuck on the disconnection screen.
[*] BUG FIX: Sometimes when you moved from keyboard to gamepad, the aim would stay on the screen
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
Know bug:
[list]
[*] When you close to the southgates and you didn't open it yet, if an event is happening you might have enemies spawing on the other side of the wall and they won't be reacheable. In this case unfortunately you will need to pause and respawn. That will be fixed for the next versions.
[/list]

notes.title: Veil of Shadows - DEMO-1.1.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Hey! We have release the version demo-1.1.0 of Veil of Shadows. This version has a great addition on its mechanics. You will understand where the enemies are coming from!

Watching all the gameplays we could during the first week of the DEMO's release, we noticed that people were having problems understand how the enemies events worked, so we decided to pull a feature taht would be implemented in the future to now and that is already live in this version.

So, the black shadow that, when you get too close, it will come to Sirene and hit her. After that waves of enemies will start to spawn until the end of what we call Enemies Event. When it's finished a chest will be given to Sirene. This chest can drop multiple different items.

If there is one tip we can give, to make the gameplay more chill is to try to stay around the area where the black shadow was, because if you find another one when you are running away from the monsters you can start another event. So, [b]face your fears[/b]! All this mechanics plays a role on the character's story and the journey will explain it to you.

Enough for this post! I hope you can play Veil of Shadows' demo and have fun!

Don't miss out on the updates! Have a blast, stay tuned for more thrills, and, oh, don't forget: 
[h2]WISHLIST NOW![/h2]

The adventure is just beginning. Thanks for all your support and love!

Don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://twitter.com/imponixgames]Twitter[/url].

[i][b]We gonna be receiving suggestions, comments and bug on [url=https://discord.gg/HSkbVPHmyG]Discord[/url] only, so, if you want to help and participate of this process, please access our Discord link above, we would so  much appreciated it! For all those that will participate we will not forget you![/b][/i]

notes.title: SteamDeck compatibility is on the way!
notes.content:
[h3]We are happy to announce that Veil of Shadows will be fully compatible with Steam Deck, like that, we target better our community.[/h3]

Knowing that Veil of Shadows has a casual gameplay and with 2D environment and sprites, this game is perfectly suitable to Steam Deck ambiance. So we decided that being 100% compatible with this platform was a must.

So, now you will be able to play it in multiple platforms, using the same save game and having fun on the go.

[h3]Don't forget to wishlist and follow us.[/h3]
* More inside information about the development process can be found on our channels:
X : [url=https://twitter.com/imponixgames]https://twitter.com/imponixgames[/url]
SubReddit: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/imponixgames]https://www.reddit.com/r/imponixgames[/url]
